clips.label: 2 paintings/s throughout
clips.details:
Sixteen paintings at half-second intervals; twelve are newly rendered. Compare the shell opening at 3–4 seconds with the other version.

Both clips are eight seconds at 24 fps. Same recurrent Krea Turbo feedback, CFG 1, three Euler intervals, staged prompts at 2/3/4 seconds, bounded Lanczos motion, and RIFE 4.25 scale 1. No added reference conditioning or blending. The noise rises from 0.40 at 2s to 0.74048 at 4s, drops to 0.25 at 4.5s and 0.10 from 5s. Interpolation never feeds back.

Both preserve the same opening paintings through 1.5s and reproduce the first fresh painting at 2s identically. Later each branch consumes its own previous painting. Extra repaints mean extra resampling and VAE cycles as well as extra model calls.
